title: Secure setuptools build-backend floor

change_control.trigger: The B02 native Windows x64 qualifier failed closed because its exact lock selected setuptools 81.0.0 and pip-audit reported PYSEC-2026-3447 / CVE-2026-59890.
change_control.necessity: The project requirement setuptools>=77,<82 forced every compliant build environment below the first fixed release. Suppressing or waiving the advisory was rejected.
change_control.scope: Narrow build-backend security and compatibility correction only. Runtime dependency profiles, supported Python, package contents, batch order, feature freeze, and B01's historical Linux-only qualification boundary do not change.
change_control.governance_handling: The original B01 closure remains immutable historical evidence for its exact Linux x86_64 environment. This amendment governs builds after its change commit and must pass package, audit, documentation, and governance revalidation before the corrected B02 commit is offered for native rerun.

superseded_requirement.security_result: affected versions only; native Windows resolution selected 81.0.0
superseded_requirement.preservation: The old value remains visible in historical commits and the B02 failed-diagnostic record, not in the current package authority.

minimum.reason: first fix version reported by the native pip-audit evidence for PYSEC-2026-3447 / CVE-2026-59890

upper_bound.reason: preserves a narrow reviewed major/minor window; later versions require explicit compatibility review

amended_requirement.known_compatible_exact_version: 84.0.0 from the existing CPython 3.11 Linux x86_64 dev lock
amended_requirement.runtime_import_check: No production source imports pkg_resources or setuptools APIs.

advisory.summary: Unicode-normalization collisions can bypass MANIFEST.in exclusions while building source distributions on normalization-preserving macOS filesystems.

authoritative_sources.supports: Vendor advisory, affected range, impact, and technical details.
CVE identity and external vulnerability record.

required_revalidation: install the exact Linux dev lock containing setuptools 84.0.0 and install OMNI locally with no build isolation or dependency resolution
run pip check and a current exact-lock pip-audit
build wheel and sdist with no isolated dependency resolution
run install and package contract tests with exact-lock sdist bootstrapping
run package-content and Twine metadata checks
run configuration, static, documentation-link, and governed-authority checks
rerun both native Windows B02 lanes against the same new exact commit
nonclaims: The failed f8908503 native x64 lane is not converted into a pass.
Linux build compatibility does not qualify either native Windows lane.
No Arm64 or physical DGX behavior is established by this amendment.
B02 remains open and B03 remains locked.

validation.scope: The corrected source, exact Linux developer environment, artifacts, security reports, frontend, configuration, documentation, and governance passed local revalidation. This remains non-native evidence; both native Windows B02 lanes must rerun against one new exact commit before the amendment or B02 can receive a fully qualified outcome.

results.result: setuptools>=83,<85; regression tests accept 83.0.0 and 84.0.0 and reject 82.0.1 and 85.0.0
exact hashed dev lock installed setuptools 84.0.0; local OMNI 3.2.0 installation used --no-build-isolation --no-deps; pip check passed

current pip-audit inspected 88 of 91 exact-lock distributions, conditionally omitting packaging, pip, and setuptools, and reported zero findings; license inventory covered all 91 with no missing, unknown, or version-mismatched distributions and retained two metadata review entries
one wheel and one sdist built with --no-isolation; 195 required runtime files validated; strict Twine metadata passed
71 passed: 56 install/lifecycle/startup contracts plus 15 package/metadata/outside-checkout artifact contracts; exact-lock bootstrapping and no-isolation sdist installation were enabled
npm 12.0.2 clean installation audited 428 packages with zero vulnerabilities; install-script and dependency-tree reports, 13 proxy tests, lint, and production build passed

configuration contract, fatal and changed-file Ruff, compileall, JSON/TOML and shell syntax, local Markdown links, governed generation/check, adversarial governance self-test, and git diff check passed
